bindings: One immutable SourceReferenceConstraintContextV1 identity per tracker instance.
One nonempty externally governed decoder identity per tracker instance.
Every result repeats both identities and the SHA-256 of decoded UTF-8 text.

path_rules.incremental: Token IDs extend the prior IDs and decoded text extends the prior decoded text; feed only the decoded suffix into the prior DFA state.
path_rules.full_rebuild: Backtracking, token-prefix divergence, or decoded-prefix instability rebuilds from a fresh V2 DFA carrying the identical source context.
path_rules.hard_failure: Identical token IDs decoding to different text is decoder instability and must not be hidden by rebuilding. Non-string decode output also fails explicitly.

state_rule: Only a successfully produced state becomes the next incremental baseline; exceptions do not advance tracker state.
non_goals: No callback controller, token-trie projector, tokenizer, evaluator, runner, provider, or probe binding.
No model load, inference, Stage C, runtime/production authority, curriculum exposure, or training.
